name: Collect permitted public pages with durable budgets and continuation

parameters.jsCode:
// Match the job_id in the service config. No source URLs or tokens go here.
return [{json:{job_id:'public-docs-demo'}}];

parameters.content:
## 1. Start the included collector service
This template needs collector.py and serve.py from the accompanying package. Start in offline demo mode first. The service and n8n must share a host/network namespace.

Select a Header Auth credential on the HTTP node: Authorization: Bearer <private controller token>. Keep the value in n8n's credential store. The exported workflow contains no credential binding.

## 2. Configure a permitted source before live use
Allowlisted HTTPS origins and paths, permission confirmation, robots checks, request/byte/time budgets and pacing are enforced by the included service. No browser, authentication, paid actor launches, email harvesting or outreach.

Use the optional completed-export importer for discovery. It retains only in-scope URLs and import receipts.

## 3. Review the receipt
The workflow is manual and inactive. The service commits state to SQLite before requests and supports continuation after a restart. No automatic HTTP retries or redirects.

The final node distinguishes complete, partial and paused. Page data stays in the local store, not workflow execution output. See README for offline proof, export and recovery.
